replicaCount.description: Number of replicas. Values greater than 1 require a PostgreSQL connection string via config.databaseUrl or existingSecret. Enforced at chart render time.

tag.description: Container image tag. Defaults to the chart appVersion when empty.

imagePullSecrets.description: List of image pull secret references.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name component of generated resource names.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the full generated resource name.

create.description: Whether to create a dedicated ServiceAccount.

annotations.description: Annotations to apply to the ServiceAccount.

name.description: Name of the ServiceAccount. Defaults to the fullname when empty and create=true.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations to apply to the Pod.

podLabels.description: Extra labels to apply to the Pod.

port.description: Service port for the HTTP listener.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the ATC container.

affinity.description: Affinity rules for pod scheduling. When non-empty, fully overrides the chart's podAntiAffinity injection (see podAntiAffinity).

type.description: Anti-affinity mode. 'soft' (default) preferred with weight 100, 'hard' required, 'off' omits the chart-injected rule. Overridden by a non-empty affinity value.

httpAddr.description: Address and port the HTTP listener binds to (ATC_HTTP_ADDR).

databaseUrl.description: Database connection URL (ATC_DATABASE_URL). See values.yaml for the two storage modes.

databaseListenerUrl.description: Listener database connection URL (ATC_DATABASE_LISTENER_URL). When empty, the listener falls back to ATC_DATABASE_URL. Set when the main pool runs through transaction-mode PgBouncer.

logFilter.description: Tracing filter string in RUST_LOG syntax (ATC_LOG_FILTER).

logFormat.description: Log output format: 'pretty', 'json', or null to let the binary decide by build type (ATC_LOG_FORMAT).

outboxRetention.description: Outbox retention age in humantime format (e.g. '7d', '24h', '90m'). Maps to ATC_OUTBOX_RETENTION. Default '7d'. Minimum supported is '1h' — sub-floor values fail process startup (Postgres `inserted_at` is transaction-start, not commit, time; shorter retention is unsafe under MVCC). See ADR 0007.

displayTtl.description: Display TTL in humantime format (e.g. '1h', '30m', '2h'). Maps to ATC_DISPLAY_TTL. Default '1h'. Completed runs and jobs older than `now - displayTtl` are filtered out of /v1/state and aged out of the live UI; the underlying rows persist. Restart-only. Minimum supported is '60s' — sub-floor values fail process startup. See ADR 0009.

stalenessThreshold.description: Staleness sweep threshold in humantime format (e.g. '48h', '3d'), or null to disable the sweep. Maps to ATC_STALENESS_THRESHOLD. Default '48h'. After this long with no observed webhook activity, a non-terminal run or job is force-completed with conclusion 'Stale' through the normal outbox/NOTIFY write path. Restart-only. Minimum supported is '24h' — GitHub's hosted queued-job wait ceiling, the longer of GitHub's two relevant hosted ceilings since the sweep applies one threshold to both queued and running jobs; sub-floor values fail process startup and invite false positives. null renders staleness_threshold: null into the runner-pool-config ConfigMap (mounted even with empty runnerPools) instead of the env var, since the env var always overrides the file. See ADR 0013.

webhookSecret.description: Webhook secret for HMAC-SHA256 signature validation (ATC_GITHUB__WEBHOOK_SECRET). When null and existingSecret.githubWebhook.name is also null, signature validation is disabled — the server accepts unsigned payloads. existingSecret.githubWebhook.name wins when both are set.

existingSecret.description: Per-credential references to existing Kubernetes Secrets. Each credential can reference its own Secret independently.

database.description: Existing-Secret reference for the database URL pair.

name.description: Name of the Kubernetes Secret containing the database credentials. When null, falls back to config.databaseUrl / config.databaseListenerUrl.

urlKey.description: Key inside the Secret whose value is the main pool's database URL.

listenerUrlKey.description: Key inside the Secret whose value is the listener task's database URL. When empty, the listener falls back to ATC_DATABASE_URL.

githubWebhook.description: Existing-Secret reference for the GitHub webhook signing secret.

name.description: Name of the Kubernetes Secret containing the webhook secret. When null, falls back to config.github.webhookSecret.

secretKey.description: Key inside the Secret whose value is the GitHub webhook secret.

enabled.description: Enable OpenTelemetry export. When false, no OTEL_* env vars are injected.

endpoint.description: OTLP endpoint URL (HTTP/protobuf). Required when enabled.

serviceName.description: Service name reported via OTEL_SERVICE_NAME resource attribute.

resourceAttributes.description: Comma-separated key=value pairs reported via OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES.

samplerArg.description: Sampler argument (e.g. '0.1' for 10% root sampling with traceidratio).

enabled.description: Whether to create an Ingress resource.

annotations.description: Annotations to apply to the Ingress.

enabled.description: Whether to create a Gateway API HTTPRoute resource.

parentRefs.description: parentRefs pointing at the Gateway(s) that should serve this HTTPRoute.

rules.description: Custom HTTPRoute rules. Empty generates a default catch-all rule.

preStopSleepSeconds.description: Seconds the preStop hook sleeps before SIGTERM. 0 disables the hook.

enabled.description: Whether to render a PodDisruptionBudget for the ATC Deployment.

minAvailable.description: Minimum number (integer) or percentage string (e.g. '50%') of pods that must remain available during voluntary disruptions. Mutually exclusive with maxUnavailable; the chart fails template rendering when both are set.

maxUnavailable.description: Maximum number (integer) or percentage string (e.g. '50%') of pods that may be unavailable during voluntary disruptions. Mutually exclusive with minAvailable; the chart fails template rendering when both are set.

enabled.description: Whether to render the NetworkPolicy resource.

ingress.description: Ingress rules. Each item is a networking.k8s.io/v1 NetworkPolicyIngressRule, passed through verbatim.

egress.description: Egress rules. Each item is a networking.k8s.io/v1 NetworkPolicyEgressRule, passed through verbatim.

enabled.description: Whether to render a HorizontalPodAutoscaler. When true, the Deployment's spec.replicas field is dropped.

minReplicas.description: Minimum replicas the HPA may scale down to.

maxReplicas.description: Maximum replicas the HPA may scale up to. When > 1, requires an external Postgres connection string.

targetCPUUtilizationPercentage.description: Target average CPU utilization (percentage of requested CPU). When null, the CPU metric is omitted; when set, requires resources.requests.cpu.

targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage.description: Target average memory utilization (percentage of requested memory). When null, the memory metric is omitted.

enabled.description: Whether to include the helm test hook Pod.

grafanaDashboard.description: Grafana dashboard auto-discovery. Default off. Renders a ConfigMap with the kube-prometheus-stack sidecar discovery label and, optionally, a grafana-operator v5 GrafanaDashboard CR referencing the same ConfigMap. See docs/architecture/deployment.md § Grafana dashboard.

namespace.description: Override namespace for the ConfigMap. Empty (default) renders in the release namespace.

labels.description: Discovery labels for the ConfigMap. `grafana_dashboard: "1"` is the kiwigrid/k8s-sidecar convention.

annotations.description: Annotations for the ConfigMap. `grafana_folder: "<Name>"` is the sidecar folder convention.

grafanaOperator.description: Additionally render a grafana-operator v5 GrafanaDashboard CR referencing the ConfigMap. Requires grafana-operator CRDs installed.

instanceSelector.description: Pass-through to GrafanaDashboard.spec.instanceSelector (Kubernetes LabelSelector). Only matchLabels and matchExpressions are validated structurally; the chart treats this as raw pass-through so the operator can use any LabelSelector form grafana-operator accepts.

folderRef.description: Optional name of a GrafanaFolder CR in the same namespace. Empty omits the field.

resyncPeriod.description: Optional Go duration (e.g. "5m"). Empty omits the field; the operator uses its own default.

runnerPools.description: Operator-declared runner-pool capacities. Empty (default) renders no ConfigMap and no volume mount. Non-empty renders a ConfigMap consumed by atc-server at /etc/atc/config.yaml, populating the StateSnapshot.runnerPoolCapacities wire field so the frontend can render saturation bars per pool.

labels.description: Runner labels identifying this pool (e.g. ['self-hosted', 'linux', 'x64']). Canonicalized server-side to a sorted, deduplicated set.

capacity.description: Declared upper-bound runner count for the pool. Integer >= 1, or null to declare the pool unbounded (no renderable ceiling). The `capacity` key must be present — operators declare an unbounded pool with `capacity: null` rather than by omitting the key.
